perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

enhanced.name: Strategist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate improved class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

enhanced.name: Elemental Capacitor
enhanced.description:
Substantially increases stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

enhanced.name: Pugilist

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

enhanced.name: Feeding Frenzy
enhanced.description: Each rapid final blow with this weapon progressively increases reload speed substantially for a short time.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

enhanced.name: Fragile Focus
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

enhanced.name: Target Lock
enhanced.description: Damage increases by an improved amount the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.
